content: Shopify Online Store 2.0 themes define global settings in config/settings_schema.json; theme_editor.js exposes these under a Theme Settings panel. Presets (settings_data.json) let a developer ship up to 5 preconfigured 'theme styles' — selecting one in the editor overwrites only presentational setting values (colors, fonts, etc.), never structural/section settings. A color_palette setting type shows merchants a grid of named swatches they pick from for any color field, rather than a raw color picker, keeping choices bounded to the developer-defined palette.
